testCases.name: test_evaluation[golden9]
testCases.input: Jobs for Humanity seems to post a lot of roles. How many do they have?
testCases.actualOutput: Based on the information provided, there is no mention of the total number of roles that Jobs for Humanity posts. The text only indicates that they are partnering with Capital One to build an inclusive employment ecosystem and prioritizes candidates from specific communities, but it does not provide a count of their job openings.
testCases.expectedOutput: Jobs for Humanity has 6 jobs, all onsite and Mid senior. Four are in Chattanooga, TN: Senior Software Engineer, Back End (Go, AWS, Java); Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Full Stack; Lead Software Engineer, Full Stack (JavaScript/Java/AWS); and Lead Software Engineer, Full Stack (Java, Python, Angular, React). The other two are Senior Software Engineer, Back End roles in Joliet, IL and Naperville, IL.
